name: BUSES_EXCEPTED_MMS_WHITE_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border (6 / 18 = edge 6 + border 12), as the AS 1743 drawings. RM9-SA2A 600 x 600 multi-message-frame module (1:10 sheet, 2020): black border 25, no white edge, square corners. BUSES 90 D, EXCEPTED 90 C; chain 260/170/170 (baselines): tops 170, 340. Widths BUSES 355 (125/355/120), EXCEPTED 480 (60/480/60). Multi-message frames only.
